segments.name: Health insurance marketplace
segments.description: Online marketplace where licensed brokers sell self-funded benefits plans and stop-loss policies to businesses.
segments.evidence: The Company's chief operating decision maker ("CODM"), the Chief Executive Officer and executive committee, manages the Company's business activities as a single operating and reportable segment from continuing operations at the consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Stop-loss insurance carriers pay the company for its underwriting, program and claims services.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, one stop-loss insurance carrier ("Carrier A") individually represented greater than 10% of Company's total gross revenues, accounting for 27.3 % of total gross revenues.
